adjudication.depicted_input: Browser-style CellWhisperer interface panel showing text query entry, score-based/visual cell selection, and natural-language chat over selected cells from a scRNA-seq embedding view.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop from figure 4 is an evaluation/scoring panel, so it is not a valid target-model input depiction. Figure 9 is visibly better because its interface panel directly shows the immediate user-facing input path for the CellWhisperer chat model: free-text querying plus selected-cell interaction in the transcriptome embedding interface. That supports the inference routes for free-text questions and selected-cell transcriptome embeddings, even though the internal averaging/adapter steps are not separately drawn.
